{{Taurus}}
Taurus 26 is the 166th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 26th day of Taurus, and it is a Friday. It corresponds to ISO week 24, weekday 5.

Its informal Japanese name is 6宮26日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 166|Chapter 166]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152186}}.
